expectedIssues: Section title shows the raw translation key home_feed.popular_title instead of translated text
reportedIssues: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title such as 'Popular near you'. The missing translation string is visible to end users.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use different treatments: the ramen card has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart. This inconsistency looks like a rendering bug.
In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is clipped mid-word at the screen edge with no visible affordance that the list scrolls horizontally.

The 'See all' links and promo body text are green/grey on white at small sizes; the secondary metadata ('€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light grey and may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
The notification bell has a red dot badge with no accompanying count or text label, so its state is conveyed by color alone.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 identifies the same section title displaying the raw home_feed.popular_title translation key instead of translated text.
